item.title: Nvidia Researchers Call Huge Context Windows a Dead End
item.description:
An Nvidia research team argues that ever-larger context windows are often overkill and expensive. In many tests, periodic summarization combined with targeted lookups performed about as well as stuffing entire documents into the prompt, suggesting the industry should rethink the 'longer is better' assumption.

原文标题：英伟达研究员称超大上下文窗口是死路

Why it matters：对主流“堆上下文”路线提出反直觉质疑，涉及成本与架构取舍，值得关注。

item.title: Microdrama Startup Tests Selling AI Versions of Actors' Faces
item.description:
Microdrama platform Shortical is shifting toward AI-generated content and exploring licensing deals to buy actors' facial likenesses, aiming to cut production costs. The move highlights AI commercialization attempts in short-form drama, though industry observers remain skeptical about genuine audience demand.

原文标题：微短剧公司试水 AI 换脸授权商业模式

Why it matters：揭示了 AI 肖像授权在内容产业的落地尝试与成本逻辑，对关注 AI 商业化边界的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Zero C# Compiles C# to Native Code Without Runtime or GC
item.description:
Zero C# is a fork of bflat that compiles C# straight into small native programs with no .NET runtime, no garbage collector and nothing to install on the target. It keeps C# syntax, type checking and generics while managing memory through arenas freed all at once, and the same source runs on Linux, macOS, Windows, WebAssembly and even DOS on a 386.

原文标题：Zero C# 让 C# 脱离运行时与 GC 直编原生程序

Why it matters：它展示了 C# 在无运行时、无 GC 约束下的原生编译路径，对系统编程与嵌入式场景具有实际参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Faces Pressure to Balance Safety Mission After IPO
item.description:
Anthropic went public on Nasdaq last Thursday, becoming one of the most valuable companies on the planet, but the real story is what follows: whether it can keep investing in AI safety while answering to shareholders and growing revenue fast enough to cover roughly $900 billion in compute bills over the coming years. The Verge's Decoder podcast and senior AI reporter Hayden Field unpack how that tension may play out.

原文标题：Anthropic 上市后安全优先路线面临考验

Why it matters：头部 AI 实验室上市后安全使命与股东压力的结构性冲突，是观察行业治理走向的关键样本。

item.title: Lean Community Certifies Formal Proof of Riemann Hypothesis
item.description:
The Lean and Mathlib communities jointly certified that Levent Alpöge's 17-million-line Lean library, released on November 20, 2026, correctly proves the Riemann Hypothesis, with both statement and proof vetted by experts. This marks a milestone for AI-assisted formal mathematics and machine verification reaching a top-tier open problem.

原文标题：Lean 社区正式验证黎曼猜想形式化证明

Why it matters：形式化数学社区首次认证黎曼猜想证明，对 AI for Math 与机器验证生态具有节点级意义。

item.title: South Korea President Visits SK Ulsan Data Center to Speed Up AI Race
item.description:
South Korean President Lee Jae-myung visited the Ulsan data center jointly developed by SK Group and AWS, stressing that speed is critical in the global AI race and hoping the project will attract more global AI investment. The project carries an estimated total investment of 7 trillion won, is slated to begin operations in the second half of 2027, and targets 103MW of initial capacity by 2029 with plans to expand by nearly 900MW.

原文标题：韩国总统视察 SK 蔚山数据中心 呼吁加快 AI 竞赛

item.title: OpenAI Ships New Prompt Templates for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
item.description:
OpenAI published copy-ready system prompt templates for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to correct behaviors observed in both releases, notably overly brief default answers and unnecessary clarifying questions that interrupt workflows. The templates cover writing style, initiative, and coding, with coding guidance to reuse existing code, avoid needless abstractions, and add tests only on request or for specific errors. API changes accompany the release: editing conversation history discards earlier reasoning steps, affecting token cost and response quality, while parameters such as temperature and top_p are gone.

原文标题：OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol 提示词模板

Why it matters：官方提示词模板与 API 行为变更直接影响所有使用 Astra 与 Sol 的开发者，属于可立即落地的工程实践更新。

item.title: SimpleBench Shows Top LLMs Still Trail Ordinary Humans on Common Sense
item.description:
Researchers released SimpleBench, a 200-plus-question multiple-choice benchmark covering spatio-temporal reasoning, social intelligence and linguistic adversarial trick questions. A non-specialized human baseline of 83.7% from nine participants beat every tested frontier model, with top performer Claude Fable reaching only 81.9%, showing memorized knowledge and approximate retrieval are still insufficient for basic common-sense questions.

原文标题：SimpleBench 揭示顶尖模型常识推理不及普通人

Why it matters：该基准以普通人基线反超所有前沿模型，为评估大模型真实推理短板提供了可复用的对照方法。

item.title: Samsung Storage Capacity Through 2029 Largely Sold Out
item.description:
Samsung Electronics has locked up most of its memory chip capacity for 2027 through 2029 under long-term agreements, with some customers pushing supply guarantees out to 2031. AI data center expansion has driven shortages across HBM, commodity DRAM and enterprise NAND, with major makers meeting only 60% to 70% of demand and 2027 commodity DRAM wafer capacity effectively sold out, strengthening memory vendors' pricing power.

原文标题：三星 2027 至 2029 年存储产能基本售罄

Why it matters：存储产能被长期锁定至 2031 年，直接反映 AI 算力扩张对上游供应链的结构性挤压。

item.title: China's 5G Industrial Internet Projects Reach 27,000 Across 41 Sectors
item.description:
China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology reports that nationwide 5G plus industrial internet projects have surpassed 27,000, with industrial internet now covering all 41 industrial categories and 5G applications spanning 97 national economic sectors. The country has built 1,260 5G factories and over 360 industrial internet platforms, with key platforms connecting more than 100 million industrial devices, and has opened 2026 pilot city applications.

原文标题：5G 工业互联网项目达 2.7 万个覆盖 41 个工业大类

Why it matters：官方披露的工业互联网规模化落地数据，反映 5G 与制造业融合的产业进展。

item.title: Lagarde Urges EU Public Funds to Absorb First-Loss Risk on Chip and Data Center Projects
item.description:
In her final speech before stepping down, ECB President Christine Lagarde called on the EU to use public funds, including the EU budget, to absorb first-loss risk on large chip fab and data center projects so as to crowd in private capital through cross-regional public-private partnerships. She cited an estimate that lifting Europe's share of global AI compute from about 5% to 15% by 2030 would require roughly EUR 1.3 trillion in investment.

item.title: Thinking Machines Open-Sources 26.4B Looped Transformer Inkling 2 Mini
item.description:
Thinking Machines released Inkling 2 Mini, a looped transformer that stores 24 layers but runs the middle 12 three times with shared weights, yielding 48 layer passes per token from a ~20GB checkpoint that fits on a 32GB Mac. The 26.4B-total, 3.4B-active model supports 1M context under Apache 2.0, scoring 79.2% on SWE-bench Verified and 48.2% on DeepSWE 1.1 versus 42.2% for Qwen3.8-27B, while knowledge recall lags notably.

原文标题：Thinking Machines 开源 26.4B 循环 Transformer 模型

Why it matters：循环层共享权重的小模型以 Apache 2.0 开源并可在消费级设备本地运行，为端侧与低成本推理提供新架构范式。

item.title: Gelsinger Says AI Needs 10,000x Efficiency Leap Beyond Incremental Chips
item.description:
Former Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger said at the COSM tech summit that AI demands roughly a 10,000x leap in compute efficiency, which incremental chip scaling cannot deliver, while rejecting the idea that Moore's Law is dead. He argues its revival hinges on fundamental breakthroughs in optics, power delivery, thermal management, materials and packaging, and has backed lithography, nuclear power and silicon photonics startups through Playground Global.

原文标题：基辛格称 AI 需万倍能效跃升而非渐进芯片升级

Why it matters：行业重量级人物对 AI 算力瓶颈与芯片技术路线的公开判断，并附带其投资布局线索。

item.title: Anthropic Claims Claude Proof of Riemann Hypothesis as Stanford Releases Human Draft
item.description:
Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge and Claude claim a proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, formalized in Lean for machine verification. Hours later, Stanford researcher Alessandro Masullo published an independent, fully human competing draft. The same-day collision highlights AI's real participation in frontier mathematics and reignites debate over how AI-produced results can be credibly verified.

原文标题：Anthropic 称 Claude 证明黎曼猜想 斯坦福同日发布纯人类竞争稿

Why it matters：AI 首次被宣称攻克数学界最著名的开放问题之一，且同日出现人类竞争稿，是 AI for Science 的标志性事件。

item.title: Thinking Machines Open-Sources 26.4B Looped Transformer Inkling 2 Mini
item.description:
Thinking Machines released Inkling 2 Mini, an open looped transformer that runs 12 of its 24 layers three times per token, extending internal reasoning without emitting more text. The 26.4B-parameter mixture-of-experts model activates 5.4B parameters per token, handles text and images, offers a 1M-token context window, ships under Apache 2.0, and runs on a laptop. It leads open models under 100B parameters on agentic coding benchmarks, scoring 48.2% on DeepSWE v1.1 and 46.5% on Vals Index v2.2.

原文标题：Thinking Machines 开源 264 亿参数循环 Transformer 模型

Why it matters：循环 Transformer 架构叠加小体积开源权重，为端侧推理与高效智能体编程提供了新的可复现路线。

item.title: US Tech Stocks Post Worst Weekly Loss Since Pandemic as AI Doubts Mount
item.description:
US tech stocks suffered their worst weekly loss since the pandemic as AI valuation doubts, an SEC accounting review of Nvidia and war-driven oil costs weighed on sentiment. Nvidia plunged 14% on Friday, the US semiconductor index fell 10.7% with losses across Sandisk, Micron and Broadcom, and Anthropic dropped 9.1% a day after its market debut. Investors are now questioning whether elevated chip and memory valuations remain justified.

原文标题：AI 疑虑升温 美股科技板块创疫情以来最大周跌幅

Why it matters：这是 AI 资本周期的重要情绪拐点信号，直接反映市场对 AI 芯片与模型公司估值的重新定价。

item.title: HUST and Alibaba Launch Joint AI Security Research Center
item.description:
Huazhong University of Science and Technology and Alibaba have signed a partnership to establish a joint research center on intelligent attack-defense and frontier AI security, launching nine initial projects across LLM security, agent and endpoint security, intelligent system and software security, and data collaboration with privacy protection. The work targets concrete risks such as malicious manipulation of AI agents, forged screen content, and data leakage during cross-app collaboration.

原文标题：华中科大与阿里共建 AI 安全联合研究中心

Why it matters：校企共建 AI 安全研究机构，课题方向明确指向智能体与大模型攻防，是 AI 安全治理落地的实质动作。

item.title: Grok Engineer Shares AI Coding Playbook Behind 3,000 Monthly PRs
item.description:
SpaceXAI principal engineer Lauren Tan presented her AI coding methodology at the AI Engineer CODE conference, framing the challenge as converting a low-trust agent environment into a high-trust one. She proposed a trust inverted pyramid that prioritizes code architecture and deterministic checks over natural-language rules, and stressed keeping the codebase clean and banning most code comments. She personally filed 3,000 PRs last month, while her team shipped 11,000 with only a 0.5% revert rate.

原文标题：Grok 工程师单月提交 3000 个 PR 的 AI 编程心法

Why it matters：来自一线高频 AI 编程实践者的具体方法论，对使用 Agent 写代码的团队有直接参考价值。

item.title: Tencent Yuanbao and KCL Release Group Chat Agent Memory Benchmark
item.description:
Tencent Yuanbao and King's College London's NLP team jointly released GroupAssistBench, built from 50 real group chats and 80,299 historical messages into 2,395 evaluation tasks, splitting agent memory into L1 factual recall and L2 open-ended service. Across 14 configurations, stronger recall did not imply better service: EverMemOS scored 0.621 on L1 versus 0.570 for full context, yet only 0.247 on L2 versus 0.431. The paper, code and dataset are all public.

原文标题：腾讯元宝联合 KCL 发布群聊 Agent 记忆基准

Why it matters：首个基于真实群聊构建的 Agent 记忆基准，揭示记忆召回与服务能力脱节的关键问题，且数据代码全开源。

item.title: MachinePulse Open-Sources Browser Agent Framework and 31B Decision Model
item.description:
MachinePulse AI has open-sourced Karpo Decision 31B, a low-latency decision model for agents, alongside the karpo-browser framework, a 27B Act action model, and the KBB evaluation set. On Browserbase Benchmark v2, the stack reports 89% average success at 201 seconds per task and $0.096 model cost per task, roughly 1.9x faster and about one-thirteenth the cost of the Claude Fable 5.2 setup.

原文标题：MachinePulse 开源浏览器 Agent 框架与 31B 决策模型

Why it matters：开源了专为 Agent 决策与浏览器操作设计的模型加框架组合，并给出速度与成本量级数据，对 Agent 工程实践有直接参考价值。

item.title: ByteDance Claims Three Training Steps Suffice for Competitive Open Model
item.description:
A ByteDance team, together with several US universities, argues in a new paper that today's agent training pipelines have become deeply nested and hard to attribute or reproduce, and claims that three training steps are enough to produce a competitive open model. The work positions a lean training pipeline as an alternative to stacked multi-stage recipes.

Why it matters：字节联合高校挑战多阶段训练范式，主张三步训练即可，对关注训练效率与开源模型的读者有参考价值。

item.title: China Data Bureau to Set Token Metering and Quality Standards
item.description:
At the 2026 World Computing Conference, National Data Administration head Liu Liehong said tokens have become the value anchor linking compute, models and data, with a token production-circulation-consumption ecosystem taking shape. The agency will expand token service scenarios, build metering, billing and quality assessment standards, and explicitly curb low-quality redundant construction.

item.title: GPGME Patches Critical Double Free Flaw Enabling Remote Code Execution
item.description:
The GnuPG project released GPGME 2.3.1 to fix a critical flaw (CVE-2026-129975) present in all prior versions. A crafted OpenPGP key with an extremely long user ID triggers a double free that can exfiltrate application data and potentially enable remote code execution; downstream products including Gpg4win and GnuPG Desktop have been updated in tandem.

原文标题：GPGME 修复可致远程代码执行的关键漏洞

Why it matters：涉及广泛部署的加密库关键 RCE 漏洞，所有使用 GPGME 的应用与下游发行版都需立即升级。

The feature is available to all Google AI subscribers and free in eight countries including the US, Japan and Korea. item.description:
在机器人基础设施公司 XDOF 的 Ember-0 双臂机器人基准实测中，GPT-6.2 Astra 的 16 项操作任务综合成功率从两个月前 GPT-6 Astra 的 19.6% 提升至 41.2%，实现翻倍。其中给绳子打结、展开 T 恤两项此前无模型通关的柔性物体任务首次被攻克，且提升覆盖整套任务而非单点突破。XDOF 表示该基准或不久后被模型能力饱和。

Why it matters：前沿多模态大模型在真实物理操作基准上两月翻倍并首次攻克柔性物体任务，是具身智能能力跃迁的硬信号。
